messages:
alex chan: Heads-up — customer reported a spike of 401s immediately after their CI rotated service keys at 00:20 UTC. Only affects requests routed through eu-gateway. Logs show KMS errors and a parity mismatch. Repro steps + snippets below, need quick mitigation pls.

samir (ops): Can you paste the exact error lines and the env var content from one affected pod? also which sidecar/version?

alex chan: Paste from lambda / sidecar logs: 
```
ERROR: failed to unwrap key: KMS Decrypt error: InvalidCiphertextException
request_id=abc123 region=eu-west-1
... auth check failed -> 401
```
Repro (from customer): 1) curl to /v1/generate with rotated key header 2) sometimes returns 200, sometimes 401 3) toggling feature flag in their app to force restart fixes it for a few minutes.

maya eng: Quick suspicion — Helm/CI started injecting the secret value with quotes in the last pipeline change (we saw this in another repo). If the env var ends up literally with surrounding quotes, KMS unwrap payload changes and decrypt fails. Can you dump env from a running pod?

alex chan: Dumped env from a failing pod: 
```
$ kubectl exec -it svc-eu-xxx -- printenv | grep SERVICE_KEY
SERVICE_KEY="eyJhbGciOi..."
```
Note the literal double-quotes in the value. Customer CI recently changed secret interpolation to add quoting.

samir (ops): Yep that's the problem. KMS decrypt sees different bytes. Quick mitigation: remove quotes in pod env or restart the sidecar after correcting Helm values so agent picks up the right plaintext. Commands: 
```
kubectl set env deploy/svc-eu-xxx SERVICE_KEY=$(echo $UNQUOTED_KEY)
kubectl rollout restart deploy/svc-eu-xxx
```
That should stop the 401s immediately.

erika-support: Also FYI their Vault agent had a nonzero lease_ttl so it kept serving the older wrapped value for ~5m after the CI update. Once quotes are removed, restart sidecar or evict the agent cache: `/var/run/vault-agent/agent.sock` call to refresh. Logged an incident ticket with the customer and offered the restart. :white_check_mark:

maya eng: Long term fix: change Helm values schema so CI writes unquoted strings (update template to `{{ .Values.serviceKey | quote | trimPrefix "\\\"" | trimSuffix "\\\"" }}` or better, remove extra quoting in pipeline). Add a linter step in CI to fail on env values that start/end with `"`. I'll open a small PR.

deploy-bot: deploy triggered: PR #8425 — "ci: stop adding quotes to secret interpolator" by maya — build passed.

alex chan: Great — applied emergency restart for their eu pods, confirmed 200s returning. I'll coordinate with customer for a full rollout and follow up on the Vault agent TTL change. Thanks all. :pray:

samir (ops): Filed follow-up ops task to add a probe that flags env values with leading/trailing quotes for services that use KMS unwrap.

erika-support: Customer notified and accepted workaround. Marking as resolved on our side pending PR merge and patching their pipeline.

alex chan: will add notes to the incident doc and include the exact kubectl commands + logs.
